data.name: Muwahhida
data.gender_notes: Muwahhida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-h-d', which signifies 'to make one, unify'. This name symbolizes being fully dedicated and committed to one path, cause or belief. The name Muwahhida carries the meaning “Single-minded, devoted, committed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muwahhida usually hope their child will grow to embody single-minded, devoted, committed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive for oneness with Allah
data.etymology: Muwahhida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Single-minded, devoted, committed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muwahhida total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Muwahhida
in_english.meaning: One who affirms the oneness of God, believer in monotheism
in_english.long_meaning: Muwahhida is a name that signifies one who affirms the oneness of God or a believer in monotheism. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'w-h-d', which conveys the concept of unity and oneness, this name holds profound religious significance in Islamic tradition. It reflects the fundamental belief in Tawhid, the oneness of Allah, which is a central tenet of Islam. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote individuals who uphold the unity and uniqueness of God. Spiritually, it symbolizes a person's commitment to the belief in one God and is often associated with qualities of faith, sincerity, and spiritual clarity.
